description: Originally from the beautiful island of Barbados, Dr. Arlene Beckles relocated to Norcross, GA, in 2003 after spending 18 years in New York. Her impressive career spans several industries, including finance, banking, media, entertainment, and healthcare. Known for her humor, she describes her “claim to fame” as “trying to stay out of trouble”. Dr. Beckles is a Lead Cybersecurity/Information Security Project Manager.
title: Privacy Policy | Re-elect Dr. Arlene Beckles | Georgia State House District 96
